title: Thrillium Velocity Park
description: The developer needed a signature regional attraction with a strong skyline, balanced guest mix and dependable peak-day throughput.
scope: Park master planning, Ride fabrication and integration, Electrical and civil coordination, Testing and operator training
specifications: Footprint: 18 acres | Peak capacity: 2,400 riders/hour | Anchor ride: 120° Thrillium Coaster | Safety: ASTM / EN aligned
short_description: A destination-scale thrill park anchored by a 120° coaster, swing tower and high-capacity family rides.

title: Canopy Heights Aerial Adventure
description: The brief was to unlock a steep forest site without compromising its landscape, while creating repeatable adventure experiences for mixed age groups.
scope: Terrain and load study, Zipline and course engineering, Continuous-belay safety systems, Rescue and operator training
specifications: Zipline: 500m tandem | Ropes course: 3 tiers | Peak capacity: 180 guests/hour | Safety: EN 15567 aligned
short_description: A terrain-led aerial circuit with a 500m tandem zipline, continuous-belay ropes course and net park.

title: OmniSphere 360° Dome & 12D Cinema
description: The client sought an all-weather anchor capable of programming science, culture and entertainment content throughout the day.
scope: Acoustic and sightline design, Motion platform integration, Show control programming, Commissioning and content calibration
specifications: Theatre: 48 motion seats | Projection: 360° dome | Effects: 8 synchronized systems | Control: Fail-safe PLC
short_description: A 360° projection dome paired with a 48-seat motion theatre and synchronized environmental effects.

title: SnowMist Wonderpark & Ice World
description: This metropolitan project required a premium winter experience with efficient guest circulation and tightly controlled operating conditions.
scope: Experience and zone planning, Cold-room systems integration, Ice attraction installation, Operating workflow and training
specifications: Footprint: 22,000 sq ft | Operating range: -5°C to -8°C | Peak capacity: 600 guests/day | Zones: 6 themed experiences
short_description: A sub-zero indoor snow destination with ice slides, family play zones and an immersive Alpine setting.

title: Junior City Traffic & Edutainment Park
description: The institution wanted road-safety education to become an engaging, memorable activity rather than a classroom-only programme.
scope: Learning journey design, Scaled road and signal systems, Electric vehicle fleet, Instructor and maintenance training
specifications: Circuit: 650m road network | Fleet: 28 electric vehicles | Peak capacity: 240 learners/hour | Audience: Ages 5–14
short_description: A child-scale mobility city with electric vehicles, pedestrian signals and practical road-safety learning.

title: Apex Falcon Swing Tower Experience
description: The resort developer needed a compact, high-visibility attraction that could become a recognizable coastal landmark.
scope: Wind and foundation analysis, Tower fabrication, Site erection and load testing, Certification support and training
specifications: Tower height: 32 metres | Peak capacity: 320 riders/hour | Restraints: Dual fail-safe | Safety: ASTM / EN aligned
short_description: A 32m high-altitude swing experience engineered to frame panoramic coastal views.
